subject.title: feat: add OpenClaw registry export bridge

question: Should ClawHub publish this OpenClaw registry bridge as a stable root `clawhub-schema` API now, before the account/publisher feed contract in https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2948 settles?
rationale: The code is narrow, but the unresolved choice is the long-term public API and rollout order for a cross-repo OpenClaw review/export contract, which automation cannot safely decide.

options.title: Confirm bridge contract before merge
options.body: A maintainer confirms the exported helper shape, intended feed sources, and coordination with account/publisher feeds before this public API lands.

options.title: Keep the helper internal for now
options.body: Remove or narrow the root export until the bridge can be revised without downstream compatibility commitments.

options.title: Pause behind account feed work
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2948 to settle, then re-check whether this bridge should remain separate or be folded into that feed contract.

recommendation.title: Confirm bridge contract before merge
recommendation.body: A maintainer confirms the exported helper shape, intended feed sources, and coordination with account/publisher feeds before this public API lands.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest recent owner signal for catalog feed schema compatibility and schema-v1 maintenance.
